name: com.eliteaiempire/weddings
title: Weddings
description: Weddings: read product facts and pricing. Read-only, no sign-up.

tools.name: plan_wedding
tools.description: Plan a wedding in one call: budget split, Simple/Classic/Luxury packages, vendors, and price by season and weekday. Date is optional: an exact date, a month, a season, a year, a window like 'May to Sept 2027', or 'flexible'. Budget and guests are optional too.

tools.name: search_vendors
tools.description: Find wedding vendors near a place

tools.name: build_budget
tools.description: Budget split by category for total budget, guests, optional date or window, and place

tools.name: build_package
tools.description: Simple/Classic/Luxury packages assembled from real providers within budget

tools.name: price_by_date
tools.description: Price ranges by season and weekday vs Saturday, and the cheapest windows, for a guest count and optional date or window (estimate, not a quote)

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Draft a quote request for a vendor. Without a couple API key it returns the draft only (sent=false); with a key tied to a verified couple and a saved board it sends through the weddings inbox (never emails vendors that have not joined)

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List every wedding vendor category (keys, labels, search terms)

tools.name: get_checkout_link
tools.description: Checkout URL for a plan. With no arguments: the main paid plan. Where the site supports it the URL is a Stripe-hosted Checkout session (created unpaid; a human pays, nothing is charged by this tool). A free plan is only returned when the plan is requested or the company sells nothing else.

buyer_email.description: only for sites that need the buyer's email or store handle before checkout: the human buyer's own receipt email

store_handle.description: only where the site asks for it (StoreForge): the store handle the buyer chose, 3+ chars a-z 0-9 -

accept_terms.description: ONLY where the site requires the buyer to accept its Terms/refund policy before checkout: set true only after the human buyer has read and accepted the policy links the tool lists. Never set it on your own.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Plans and fees: couples free, vendor listing free, Pro and labelled sponsored slot flat monthly, no lead fees

tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: What this company sells, who it is for, and every agent/API entry point. No account needed.

tools.name: list_pricing
tools.description: Current plans and prices in USD: plan, interval, amount_usd, currency, what_you_get. No account needed.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Find pages on this site by keyword; returns url, title and summary.
